title: Econ Sprint Accelerator: experiments portfolio and rollout plan
creator: Anika Shah
description: Goal: Create a tightly prioritized portfolio of small, fast, measurable experiments that deliver unit-cost reductions for real customer workloads while preserving quality. This initiative bundles targeted batching, prefix/KV prefetching, and quantization profile experiments into a repeatable sprint cadence (2-week experiment sprints) so the Product, Eng, and Applied ML teams can run 6–8 rapid field trials per quarter and ship reproducible savings playbooks.
objectives_and_key_results: OKR1: Reduce median per-token cost for mid-tail traffic by 15% in Q2 through batching+cache improvements
OKR2: Validate 3 quantization profiles on customer workloads with <=2% quality regression vs baseline
OKR3: Create an experiment-runbook and dashboard that surfaces per-experiment ROI within 48 hours of data availability
success_metrics: quality-delta-threshold: <= 2% metric regression on chat BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-similarity depending on workload
experiment-throughput: run >=6 experiments per quarter with clear ROI calculations
time-to-ROI: experiments with positive ROI identified within 4 weeks
milestones: Milestone 1: Experiment framework and instrumentation live (A/B plumbing + cost attribution) - 2025-03-15
Milestone 2: First three field experiments (batching, KV-prefetch, low-bit quant) executed - 2025-04-05
Milestone 3: Playbook draft + runbook published in Confluence - 2025-04-20
Milestone 4: Rollout plan for positive experiments and guardrails - 2025-04-30
approach_and_scope: Sprint cadence: 2-week scoped experiments; one experiment per team concurrently (PM+Eng+Applied ML)
Experiment types: request-level batching policies, KV-prefetch heuristics, per-model quantization profiles (4/8/16-bit candidates)
Traffic selection: start with non-critical mid-tail customer traffic cohorts and traffic mirror for shadow runs
Data needed: token-level cost traces, per-request latency, quality metrics tied to evaluation prompt sets, per-route model version mapping
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Quality regressions impacting customers - Mitigation: start on mirrored traffic + strict quality gate (automatic rollback)
Risk: Instrumentation gaps leading to noisy ROI - Mitigation: instrument token attribution and build 'cost delta' dashboard before experiments
Risk: Infra contention during aggressive batching tests - Mitigation: schedule experiments during low-peak windows and cap concurrency
deliverables: Experiment harness updates (A/B framework + cost attribution) - GH PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1294
Confluence: Econ Sprint Accelerator runbook and playbook - https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/ESprint
Dashboard: per-experiment ROI tile in Console (prototype dashboard link) - https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/econ-sprint
Final: rollout checklist and automated rollback policy for each winning experiment
